services.name: Mary M. Miller - New Year's Bash 21+
services.desc: Cruise into the New Year onboard the Mary M. Miller! Duration 3 hours Boarding Information Please arrive 30 minutes prior to your cruise. About Ring in the New Year from the river! Climb aboard the Mary M. Miller riverboat and cruise into 2024 in style on our annual New Year’s Bash cruise. This New Year's Event is your chance to: - Sip on champagne (included in your ticket!) as we count down the minutes to 2024 - Dance your troubles away with music from DJ Jill—she’s always a good time. - Complimentary party favors are provided, so raise a glass and make a toast to the New Year with us on the river! services.name: Belle - Steamboat Supper
services.desc: Set your sights on an Evening Leisure cruise with Meal! Duration 2 hours About Come aboard for a hearty and delicious meal while you enjoy the sights and sounds of the river as we show you the town from an all-new perspective—out on the water. Grab a cocktail from our full bar, then sit back, relax and enjoy your meal. This is a two-hour excursion. More info Boarding begins 60 minutes prior to your cruise. What's included Buffet-style dinner Coffee, Lemonade and Water included Drinks available for purchase at full bar Live music Sample menu - Garden Salad with fresh romaine, sliced red onion, grapevine tomato, crisp cucumbers and herb croutons with choice of two dressings Burgundy Beef Tips
